song.title: Damn Right, I've Got The Blues

guitar.notes: Confirmed — Buddy Guy's polka-dot Fender Stratocaster is one of the most iconic blues guitar associations.

tone.target: gritty Chicago blues lead with warm tube bite
tone.profile: gritty Chicago blues lead with warm tube bite
tone.summary: A classic Chicago blues setup using a Tube Screamer boost into a vintage British amp model (UK 45/50) with a focused cab, adding chorus for dimension and delay for sustain.
corrections: favor amp breakup over pedal distortion
add a little room only if needed
